title: Superstrings
lead: Superstring theory is an attempt to unify gravity with the other three forces. This section describes its picture of fundamental particles as tiny vibrating strings, the smallest size that quantum gravity suggests space may have, and why experiment can do little yet to guide the theory.
objectives: Explain the relationship between Superstring theory and the Big Bang.
summary_html: • Superstring theory holds that fundamental particles are one-dimensional vibrations analogous to those on strings and is an attempt at a theory of quantum gravity.

exercises.prompt: The characteristic length of entities in Superstring theory is approximately $10^{-35}\;\text{m}$. (a) Find the energy in GeV of a photon of this wavelength. (b) Compare this with the average particle energy of $10^{19}\;\text{GeV}$ needed for unification of forces.

parts.hint: A photon’s energy is $E = hc/\lambda$, and $hc = 1240\;\text{eV}\cdot\text{nm}$; convert the wavelength to nanometers and the energy from eV to GeV.
